ecosystem-services.title: Ecosystem services
ecosystem-services.about: What nature here provides for free, such as clean water, flood protection and carbon storage. The brighter the colour, the more a place provides.

connectivity-linkages.title: Connectivity linkages
connectivity-linkages.about: The easiest routes for wildlife to travel between areas of good habitat. The brighter the colour, the stronger the link.

landscape-permeability.title: Landscape permeability
landscape-permeability.about: How easily wildlife can move across the land. Roads, towns and clearings make it harder. The brighter the colour, the easier the going.

refugia.title: Micro-refugia × Macro-refugia
refugia.about: Places sheltered from the worst of a warming climate. Gold: small local shelters, like cool valleys and shaded slopes. Purple: sheltered across the wider region. Deep red: both.

human-footprint.title: Cumulative human impacts
human-footprint.about: How strongly people have changed the land, from roads and towns to logging and mines, all added together. The brighter the colour, the heavier the footprint: where reconnecting the land matters most.

sensitivity-buffer.title: Ecosystem sensitivity × Climate buffer
sensitivity-buffer.about: When it's ready, this map will show sensitive places that will stay buffered as the climate changes: where restoration counts most.
sensitivity-buffer.source: Ecosystem Sensitivity (Nature Squamish, 2026) · Climate Microrefugia (J. Stolar, 2026)

integrity-habitat.title: Ecosystem integrity × Critical habitat
integrity-habitat.about: When it's ready, this map will show the intact places that also hold critical habitat: where protection counts most.
integrity-habitat.source: Ecosystem Integrity (TerrAdapt, 2022) · SARA Critical Habitat (J. Stolar, 2026)

human-footprint-change.title: Change in human footprint
human-footprint-change.about: Where the human footprint has grown over forty years. The brighter the colour, the more it has grown. The darkest ground has changed little, or recovered.
